Two Factor Authentication
=======================

This guide explains how to enable two factor authentication for the user accounts.


Two factor authentication is a security feature that requires a user to enter a code from their mobile phone to log in to the system.
The client comes with a built-in two factor authentication module which is available for use.

In order to enable two factor authentication for your account, please follow the steps below:

#. Go to the accounts page by going the to the Accounts & Multifactor Authentication page (See the Account Links section).
#. If you have not already added a email address to your account, please add one by clicking on the "Add Email" button. 
#. Click on the link titled Two-Factor Authentication.
#. Click on the Activate button on the page that loads. You will be reprompted for your password.
#. You will be asked to scan a QR code with the Google Authenticator app on your mobile phone. 
#. Enter the code generated by the app in the field provided.
#. Click on the Activate button on the page that loads.
#. You can then create backup codes by clicking on the "Create Backup Codes" button. Download these and store them in a secure location.
#. Next time you log in, you will be asked to enter the code generated by the app in addition to your password.
